title: hieracium inulifrons
intro: Hieracium inulifrons, commonly known as Hawkweed, is a flowering plant species in the dandelion family (Asteraceae). It is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to aid in wound healing, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties, making it a promising therapeutic agent for various applications. The therapeutic actions of Hieracium inulifrons can be attributed to its bioactive constituents, including sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids. Further research is needed to confirm the full extent of its health benefits and therapeutic potential.
